media.description:
In a world where awakened beings called “Hunters” must battle deadly monsters to protect humanity, Seong Jin-U, nicknamed “the weakest hunter of all mankind,” finds himself in a constant struggle for survival. One day, after a brutal encounter in an overpowered dungeon wipes out his party and threatens to end his life, a mysterious System chooses him as its sole player: Jin-U has been granted the rare opportunity to level up his abilities, possibly beyond any known limits. Follow Jin-U’s journey as he takes on ever-stronger enemies, both human and monster, to discover the secrets deep within the dungeons and the ultimate extent of his powers.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

media.description:
Ten years after humanity’s fall, Earth lies under demonian rule. After losing his sister and his life, Yoon is offered one last chance by an angel statue. Sent back in time with a leveling system, he must reach Lv. 99 to save her and change Earth’s fate. Yoon fights, not for the world, but for her. One brother’s journey to save his sister may be humanity’s last hope.

(Source: Tapas)

media.description:
In a world of gates, monsters, and hunters galore, Soo-Ho Sung is…well, he’s just an ordinary college student. Sure, his parents went missing right before the gates started appearing three years ago, and he occasionally had a weird dream where he could beat up monsters and level up like a video game, but other than that? There’s absolutely nothing special about him. So when a sudden monster outbreak occurs on his campus, he must fight back every instinct screaming at him to run away as he takes a page out of his dad’s book and rushes to save his classmate. The chances of making it alive are looking bleak, until—PING! [Congratulations on becoming a Player.]

(Source: Ize Press)
